scope: Pure Python specification and validation only; no Docker document, executor, MCP endpoint or restore integration.

binding: private expected plan ID and digest
snapshot ID and pinned ciphertext SHA-256
manifest, owner receipt and staging receipt SHA-256
contract.trusted_context: Internal frozen Python dependencies only. A future reviewed bridge must privately load and verify the plan, signatures, full staging inventory, generation, engine inventory and capacity under an operation lock. Public hashes, verified flags and JSON proof objects are not authority.
contract.mutation_safety: Capture a detached canonical plan before validation; return a detached validated specification; cleanup consumes only validated snapshots.
contract.topology: Two disposable containers, three distinct create-only volumes (PostgreSQL data, PostgreSQL WAL, MinIO data), one create-only internal network; no ASA application instance.
contract.resource_selection: Names derive from the private operation ID. Every existing container, volume or network name is excluded at creation admission. All mounts and network membership are rebuilt from the verified plan, not selected by a public caller.
forbidden: published ports, live networks and host network/PID/IPC
privileged, devices, Docker socket and host binds
public DSN, credential values, URLs, commands and arbitrary Docker arguments
live PostgreSQL fallback, reusable live credentials and public execution flags
contract.limits: Per-service CPU/RAM/swap, bounded tmpfs and shared memory, separate hard data/WAL/object quotas, logs, PID count and maximum lifetime; unknown hard quota support or insufficient creation capacity blocks.
contract.cleanup: Exact private creation journal plus current complete inventory and fresh matching engine/kind/name/native identity/labels; reject in-use resources and observations before creation. Historical source proof and zero spare capacity do not prevent identity matching. Expired plans remain blocked; orphan recovery is not implemented.
contract.volume_identity: Requires an immutable native quota-backend allocation identity; Docker volume names or copied labels alone are insufficient.
contract.credentials: Only unique temporary principals and nonsecret secret-slot identifiers; fresh private credential provisioning is not implemented.

synthetic_validation.side_effect_guards: Every builder, validator and cleanup call runs with process execution, network sockets, SQL connections, filesystem I/O and existing restore/staging boundaries denied and asserted unused.
negative_coverage: all existing-name collisions; live/shared volumes and live PostgreSQL DSN/host
live Compose networks, published ports, host namespaces, privileged, devices, socket and binds
public credentials, commands, URLs, extra schema fields and boolean/integer confusion
plan rehash, expiry, mutation, generation and operation substitution
snapshot/source/manifest/receipt mismatch, missing proof, wrong owner and unapproved image pins
CPU/RAM/disk/WAL/tmpfs bounds, unavailable hard quotas and insufficient capacity
foreign cleanup identity, copied/changed labels, stale/missing inventory or inspect, in-use resource
caller mutation after validation, delayed cleanup lifecycle and new-source execution bypass
